text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...Ouch! Damn it, it's been like this all 
morning...!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The medicine isn't working either, huh... 
Hum... "Pain, pain, go away..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's a little spell to make the pain go 
away. Whenever I got hurt, Mama always 
sang it for me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Ouch... Maybe it doesn't work anymore 
now that I'm older.

"Worried about her weakened state from the 
headache, I stayed by her side for a while 
afterward."
